Name: ABC Fun
Overview:
ABC Fun is an educational game which is meant to teach young children ABC in a fun and interactive way.

The player controls his/her avatar and walks along the alphabet (displayed as kid's blocks). Every time the player stops, the letter is read out loud and an example of an item or animal is displayed (such as A is for Ant). The avatar can also use special effects such as a burst of stars or fire and flames on the blocks to make them spin and more. The avatar animates randomly between all sorts of movement types, such as swimming, laughing and running, all to stimulate the young participants.
